en: The postcard features two main illustrated depictions. On the left, there is a statue of a man on horseback labeled 'Statue de Mohamed Ali' with a few people dressed in traditional clothing standing nearby. On the right, a larger view shows a fort on a hill labeled 'Fort Napoléon' with the cityscape and fortifications under a yellow-toned sky. Decorative foliage is included between the images. French text is present on the card, as well as some handwritten notes.
